consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the 1970-09-18 show at Fillmore East features an outstanding performance with a great setlist, despite some issues with sound quality in parts of the recording. The energy and musicianship displayed by the band, particularly in the latter half of the show, are frequently praised.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.2 for 25 reviews + 0.5 sentiment: While many fans highlight the exceptional performance and song selection, the sound quality issues in parts of the recording lead to a more tempered overall sentiment.
